name: Height-based Fog with Directional In-scatter
definition: A height-based fog technique that adds a directional in-scatter term to simulate aerial perspective, making distant objects appear hazy and colored by the sky/sun, ensuring distance perception is maintained.
summary: Height-based Fog with Directional In-scatter simulates aerial perspective by adding directional in-scatter to height-based fog, making distant objects hazy and colored by the sun.
